purpose: Measure how often the existing after-cost screen detects known synthetic signals.
controls: Same synthetic baseline for every injection within a seed. One sparse event per four sessions. Every scenario searches the frozen 90 rules and three marked timed holds, applying identical costs, folds, and hard checks.
interpretation: Report hard-check pass counts and rankings at each strength. Negative controls and detectable strong signals check the machinery. Weak-signal power is separate from genuine market evidence and does not substitute for exact VMM calibration.
